title: Illumination of Scripture
definition: The illumination of Scripture is the gracious work of the Holy Spirit by which He helps believers understand, receive, love, and rightly respond to God's written Word.
summary: Illumination does not add new Scripture; it opens hearts to understand and embrace the Word already given.
christFocus: The Spirit illuminates Scripture to glorify Christ and lead believers into Gospel-shaped obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Illumination of Scripture teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to illumination of scripture by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
